errors.error_description: Introduced an unreachable FSM state by adding ST_UNUSED to the enum without any transition into it.
Used 4-state equality (===) in synthesizable control logic to detect zero requests, which is unsafe for synthesis semantics.
Created an unintended latch by conditionally assigning 'grant' in an always_comb block without an else path or default assignment.
Used a modulus operation in RTL (dbg_metric <= dbg_accum % 7), inferring an expensive divider and leading to suboptimal hardware.
